title: Grinding Axe
simplified_paragraphs: 有个工人在一家木材厂找到了一份工作，报酬不错，工作条件也好，所以他很珍惜，下决心要好好干。
第一天，老板给了他一把锋利的斧子。这一天，这个工人砍了18棵树。老板说："不错，就这么干!”工人很受鼓舞，第二天，他干得更加起劲，但是他只砍了15棵树。第三天，他加倍努力，可是只砍了10棵。工人觉得很惭愧，跑到老板那儿道歉，说自己的力气好像越来越小了。
老板问他："你上一次磨斧子是什么时候?”"磨斧子?”工人诧异地说，"我每天忙着砍树，哪里有时间磨斧子!”老板笑着说："不是你的力气变小了，而是因为你的斧子已经不像第一天那样锋利了。”
traditional_paragraphs: 有個工人在一家木材廠找到了一份工作，報酬不錯，工作條件也好，所以他很珍惜，下決心要好好幹。
第一天，老闆給了他一把鋒利的斧子。這一天，這個工人砍了18棵樹。老闆說："不錯，就這麼幹!”工人很受鼓舞，第二天，他幹得更加起勁，但是他只砍了15棵樹。第三天，他加倍努力，可是只砍了10棵。工人覺得很慚愧，跑到老闆那兒道歉，說自己的力氣好像越來越小了。
老闆問他："你上一次磨斧子是什麼時候?”"磨斧子?”工人詫異地說，"我每天忙著砍樹，哪裏有時間磨斧子!”老闆笑著說："不是你的力氣變小了，而是因為你的斧子已經不像第一天那樣鋒利了。”

english_paragraphs: A worker found a job in a lumber factory. The pay was good and the working conditions were good, so he cherished it and was determined to do a good job.

On the first day, the boss gave him a sharp axe. On this day, the worker cut down 18 trees. The boss said: "Yes, let's do it!" The worker was very encouraged. The next day, he worked even harder, but he only cut down 15 trees. On the third day, he worked harder, but only cut down 10 trees. The worker felt very ashamed and went to the boss to apologize, saying that his strength seemed to be getting weaker and weaker.

The boss asked him: "When was the last time you sharpened an axe?" "Grinding an axe?" The worker said in surprise, "I am busy cutting trees every day, so how can I have time to sharpen an axe!" The boss smiled and said, "It's not that your strength has become smaller, but because your ax is not as sharp as the first day."
english_full:
A worker found a job in a lumber factory. The pay was good and the working conditions were good, so he cherished it and was determined to do a good job.

On the first day, the boss gave him a sharp axe. On this day, the worker cut down 18 trees. The boss said: "Yes, let's do it!" The worker was very encouraged. The next day, he worked even harder, but he only cut down 15 trees. On the third day, he worked harder, but only cut down 10 trees. The worker felt very ashamed and went to the boss to apologize, saying that his strength seemed to be getting weaker and weaker.

The boss asked him: "When was the last time you sharpened an axe?" "Grinding an axe?" The worker said in surprise, "I am busy cutting trees every day, so how can I have time to sharpen an axe!" The boss smiled and said, "It's not that your strength has become smaller, but because your ax is not as sharp as the first day."
